_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Member 1 of 12 in the bookkeeping-waterschappen-bbv-variant chain (ADR-032). Declares the two declarative-config registers the rest of the chain reads: BBVProgramme (annual policy programme master) and BudgetBBVMapping (GL-account-to-programme allocation junction). Both schemas are admin-write / public-read (ADR-005) and OpenRegister-managed (ADR-022): no app-local mapper tables, no ALTER TABLE. BBVProgramme is the governance anchor: one record per fiscal-year programme code. Admin-maintained and never hard-deleted (archive only via the status enum, design D1). BudgetBBVMapping is a many-to-one junction from a GL account to a BBV programme, carrying an allocation percentage and an effective-date window (design D2). Both carry many-to-one relations to Administration; BudgetBBVMapping additionally relates to BBVProgramme and Account. Slugs are concise to stay inside the 30-character magic-table cap (BudgetBBVMapping → oc_openregister_shillinq_budgetbbvmapping). The English BBVProgramme slug deliberately differs from the Dutch BBVProgramma schema added by the SUPERSEDED add-shillinq-waterschappen-bbv-variant change so the two surfaces co-exist while the chain rolls out. No imperative code lives in this slice. Services, controllers, dashboards and UI are owned by chain members 02-12.

BBVProgramme.title: BBV Programme
BBVProgramme.description: A BBV (Besluit Begroting en Verantwoording) policy-programme master record for a single fiscal year. Each waterboard maintains its own programme taxonomy aligned with the BBVW kostentoedeling structure. Records are admin-maintained and SHALL NOT be hard-deleted: operators archive a programme by transitioning status to 'archived'. Records are scoped per Administration via administrationId, making (administrationId, programmeCode, fiscalYear) the natural key the seed loader and downstream UI rely on.

programmeCode.description: Waterboard-assigned BBV programme code. Unique within (administrationId, fiscalYear).
programmeCode.title: Programme Code

programmeName.description: Human-readable Dutch programme name displayed in dashboards and exports.
programmeName.title: Programme Name

description.description: Optional operator-authored description of the programme scope and policy intent.
description.example: Core administrative programme covering general administration, board support and shared services.
description.title: Description

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year the programme applies to. Together with programmeCode + administrationId this is the natural key.
fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year

status.description: Lifecycle status. Programmes SHALL NOT be hard-deleted; transitioning to 'archived' hides the programme from new mapping pickers while preserving historical references (design D1).
status.title: Status

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this programme (many-to-one). Scopes uniqueness of programmeCode + fiscalYear.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

BudgetBBVMapping.title: Budget BBV Mapping
BudgetBBVMapping.description: A many-to-one junction record linking a GL account to a BBV programme with an allocation percentage. Multiple mappings per GL account are allowed when allocationPercentage values sum to 100 across active mappings: the aggregation service in chain member 02 enforces the sum invariant. The effectiveFrom / effectiveTo window lets operators re-cut allocations between fiscal years without losing the prior split. Records are admin-write / public-read (ADR-005).

glAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber within the same administration.
glAccountNumber.title: GL Account Number

programmeCode.description: FK to BBVProgramme.programmeCode within the same administration.
programmeCode.title: Programme Code

allocationPercentage.description: Allocation share for this (glAccount, programme) pair as a percentage 0–100. Multiple mappings on the same GL account MUST sum to 100 across active mappings: the chain member 02 aggregation service enforces the sum invariant.
allocationPercentage.title: Allocation Percentage

effectiveFrom.description: ISO-8601 date this mapping starts being honoured (inclusive).
effectiveFrom.title: Effective From

effectiveTo.description: Optional ISO-8601 date this mapping stops being honoured (inclusive). Null = open-ended.
effectiveTo.title: Effective To

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this mapping (many-to-one). Scopes uniqueness with glAccountNumber + programmeCode + effectiveFrom.
administrationId.title: Administration ID
